about.title: OUR STORY
about.subtitle: Generations of devotion to wood and heritage.
about.heading: From Kazanlak with Reverence & Love
about.p1: Nestled in the heart of the Rose Valley, our family workshop in Kazanlak brings together age-old Bulgarian woodcarving heritage with contemporary technological precision.
about.p2: We specialize in Orthodox Christian iconography and classic revival reliefs. Every piece undergoes high-precision relief shaping followed by meticulous hand-sculpting, fine sanding, and natural oil and beeswax treatment.
about.quote: "Wood is alive. Our mission is to reveal its natural warmth and create timeless pieces that will be treasured for generations to come."
about.p3: In addition to our ready-to-ship works, we gladly take on Custom Commissions tailored to your dimensions and personal vision.
about.p4: When you choose Kazanlak Woodcarving, you bring warmth, blessing, and an authentic piece of Bulgarian cultural tradition into your home.

product.faq_1_a: Yes, every carving arrives with pre-installed sturdy metal wall mounting hardware on the back, completely ready to hang.
product.faq_2_q: How should the woodcarving be maintained?
product.faq_2_a: The carvings are protected with natural oils and pure beeswax. Occasional dusting with a soft, dry cloth is sufficient. Avoid soaking or direct placement near intense heat sources.
product.faq_3_a: According to Orthodox tradition, icons are taken to church to receive a blessing by the person who receives or gifts them. We create them with deep respect for canonical iconography.
product.faq_4_q: Can items be made in custom dimensions or designs?
product.faq_4_a: Yes! We can create bespoke commissions according to your required dimensions or add custom engraved dedication on the back. Contact us via phone or Viber for consultation.
